acceptance: Probe all 9 TPC-Havoc V7 variants (1_v7, 2_v7, 3_v7, 4_v7, 5_v7, 7_v7, 9_v7, 10_v7, 11_v7) against Trino and document which require dialect rewrites.
Extend benchbox/core/tpchavoc/dialect_compat.py and benchbox/sql_compat/rules/query_adapter/ to register and apply the required Trino TPC-Havoc rewrites.
Regenerate docs/compat/capability-matrix.md via make compat-docs and verify make compat-docs-check passes.
Add unit tests in tests/unit/tpchavoc/ covering Trino dialect rewrites and rule registration.
context: Follow-up from PR #3003 (issue #3001), which scoped the V7 rewrites strictly to target_dialect == 'presto' because live SF10 verification was executed on Presto C++ and Presto Java rather than Trino.
description: PR #3003 added Presto-specific query-adapter rewrites for 9 TPC-Havoc V7 variants in benchbox/core/tpchavoc/dialect_compat.py (SELECT-alias inlining in HAVING/WHERE for 3_v7, 4_v7, 5_v7, 7_v7, 9_v7, 10_v7, and 11_v7; window FILTER rewrite for 2_v7; and ARRAY_AGG + CROSS JOIN UNNEST rewrite for 1_v7) gated on target_dialect == 'presto'. TrinoAdapter (benchbox/platforms/trino.py:61) and AthenaAdapter (benchbox/platforms/athena.py:422) share PrestoTrinoAdapterBase and emit target_dialect == 'trino', which shares Presto's SQL analyzer rejection of SELECT aliases in HAVING/WHERE and DuckDB LIST* functions. Verify which of the 9 V7 variants fail on live Trino, extend dialect_compat.py and sql_compat rules to trino where required, and regenerate docs/compat/capability-matrix.md.
